headline: Settle a story with its base before the queue has to

V26-3577.title: Print how to finish a conflicted authorized base merge, so its message stays exact

criteria.text: c1: The authorization's output says how to finish the merge when it conflicts, with the exact message.
c2: A conflicted authorized merge finished as printed carries the review at hand-off.
c3: A message that differs only by git's conflict comment lines is either accepted or refused with the exact amend command.

V26-3576.title: Carry a review across a base merge whose only change to a lane-owned file is the base's own addition

criteria.text: c1: After an authorized base merge whose resolution keeps both sides' additions in a lane-owned file, and leaves the story delta unchanged, handoff carries the last aligned review.
c2: A merge whose resolution changes the story delta still needs a new round.
c3: The refusal, when it happens, names the lines of the story delta that changed.

V26-3572.title: Have a lane merge the base before it hands off, so the queue doesn't find the conflict

criteria.text: c1: handoff refuses a candidate that conflicts with the current base outside the regenerable paths, naming the files and printing the merge command.
c2: A lane can merge the base itself before hand-off, and its last aligned review carries when the story delta is unchanged.
c3: The lane brief says to merge the base, rerun gates and checks, and hand off, in that order.
c4: A conflict-free candidate on an unmoved base hands off as today.

V26-3549.title: Let the merge queue merge a candidate's new provenance outputs when the base only changed digests

criteria.text: A candidate that adds outputs syncs over a base whose lock changed only in digests, with no stop, and the merged lock lists both sides' outputs with current digests.
A candidate and base that both changed the listing still stop with source_conflict.

V26-3557.title: Let the lead replace a failing candidate's head, and end a base re-run nobody needs

criteria.text: c1: A hand-off at a new head for a story whose check failed is accepted once any of its checks has failed, while the rest of its check run or its base re-run is still running, and the lead can accept it.
c2: Accepting it ends the old head's re-run, journalled as superseded with no verdict; the old head is never checked again.
c3: The lead can record the base broken at a named head, check and test, with a reason, before a re-run's verdict, and name the repairing candidate in the same step.
c4: A re-run ended by the lead leaves no candidate re-queued at the failed head.
c5: A re-run that finishes after it was superseded writes no verdict that contradicts the lead's entry.
c6: With no lead decision and no new hand-off, a failed check re-runs on the base exactly as today.
c7: The live view shows a running base re-run with its purpose and expected end, and names the lead's alternatives.
c8: The guide says when ending a re-run early is sound, and that the lead's entry is then the evidence for the base's state.

finish.text: The integration base is reviewed for main, as the orchestrate-work guide's integration review says, and merged into main

finish.text: V26-1654 is closed by Decision 4: a round forced by a base merge counts against the bound

approvals.text: The operator approves this plan before `lead-setup`.
The operator grants lanes `push` and `draftPullRequests`, and the lead `readyPullRequests` (granted 2026-11-17).
The operator approves merging `integrate/settle-with-base` into `main` after its review.

outOfScope: Skipping the base re-run by default. With no lead decision and no new hand-off, a failed check re-runs on the base exactly as today.
Letting a lane end a re-run without a hand-off the lead accepts.
Requiring a base merge when the base moved without a conflict (Decision 2).
Test flakes that make the queue journal `base.broken` (V26-3573, V26-3478).

V26-3553's gap "the queue's sync merge blocks a lane's next push". After V26-3572, a candidate that merged the current base gets no sync commit unless the base moves again, so that gap arises less often. It is not closed here.
V26-3564, which tells a lane about a change outside its ground before hand-off. V26-3572's conflict check runs before the ownership check at hand-off, and does not replace it.
